ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated against the pinned SHA-256.
All six numbered sections, both internal page boundaries, attributions, and the opening/closing Tolstoy aphorisms are represented.
уроды is rendered monstrosities in the Schopenhauer passage, preserving the harsh source wording rather than softening the quotation.
войну не на живот, а на смерть is rendered a war not for life but to the death, retaining the idiom and its intensity.
Attributed passages are translated from Tolstoy’s compiled Russian wording, not substituted from independent English editions.
